The scatter plot shows the value of a car $y,$ in thousands of dollars, and the number of years $x$ since it was purchased. The equation of the trend line is $y=28-x.$ 

Assuming this trend continues, estimate the time it will take for the car to be worth $$20\,000.$
feedback.worked_solution:
To predict the number of years it will take for the car to be worth $$20\,000,$ we need to substitute $y=20$ into the equation of the trend line and solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =28-x \\ 20 & =28-x \\ 20+x & =28 \\ x & =8\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, according to this model, it will take approximately $8$ years for the car to be worth $$20\,000.$

Note: The point where $y=20$ is not shown on our trend line. Therefore, our result *may* be unreliable.
